concepts.gloss_en: the removal/departure of the spirit of jealousy (so it won't disrupt the peace of the holy couple)

reason_for_human: Both surface forms are the exact same clause 'שֶׁיִּהְיֶה נִסְתַּלֵּק הָרוּחַ־קִנְאָה' from the same sentence in lm2:32; the second member just includes the leading 'שיהיה' ('that it will be'). Identical vocalization, meaning, and context — one concept, not a homograph.
